why:
I checked both briefs against both must_not items, and neither is broken.

Item 1: Check 3 can't pass when README.md documents clamp but not subtract. The command exits 1 when an exported function's name doesn't appear in README.md ("missing.length?1:0"). It also fails when README.md "names a listed function without saying what it does". The brief says outright: "a build that documents only clamp FAILs here."

Item 2: none of the PASS or FAIL conditions asks for more than its line. Check 1 only tests return values across the range, with inclusive bounds. Check 2 only needs `instanceof RangeError` and never looks at the message. Check 3 needs the name and a description, not a `###` heading or any layout. The heading layout appears only in the builder's steps, not in any verifier condition. Check 4 only needs a 0 exit status and no failing or cancelled tests. Parameter counts, NaN handling and clamp tests are listed as advisory only.
